recentItems.title: Downtown Phoenix YMCA closing after 70 years
recentItems.description: After nearly 75 years, the oldest YMCA in the Valley is closing.

recentItems.title: Young family killed in head-on crash, driver arrested
recentItems.description: DPS has confirmed that Valley family of four was killed in a head-on collision near Heber yesterday.

recentItems.title: Downtown Phoenix YMCA to close after more than 70 years
recentItems.description: The Lincoln Family Downtown YMCA will close at the end of the month as leaders consider plans for a new facility at the site.

recentItems.title: Lincoln Family Downtown YMCA set to close at end of month
recentItems.description: YMCA officials say the 1952 downtown Phoenix building has reached the end of its usable life, but the organization will retain the property.

recentItems.title: DPS identifies family killed in head-on crash on SR 260
recentItems.description: The Arizona Department of Public Safety identified a young family of four from the Valley as the people killed in a head-on crash on SR 260 on Labor Day.

recentItems.title: New Mexico man arrested in connection to deadly crash near Heber
recentItems.description: A 21-year-old man from New Mexico was arrested by Arizona Department of Public Safety in connection to a crash that killed four people on Highway 260 on Labor Day.

recentItems.title: Are 'Darty’s' replacing parties in colleges?
recentItems.description: Darty’s are daytime parties and most often are alcohol free. A Florida fraternity recently threw a wellness darty and the internet reacted.

recentItems.title: Grand Canyon National Park community meeting
recentItems.description: The Grand Canyon National Park Service provides updates on continued flood response and water supply restoration efforts.

recentItems.title: Hobbs highlights bipartisan business support at Capitol bill signing
recentItems.description: As election season heats up, Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs highlighted bipartisan cooperation with business leaders.

recentItems.title: Abrazo West earns top recognition for stroke care
recentItems.description: It's the only Arizona hospital west of I-17 with the top designation.
